home.title: GM Assistant — Knave 2e
home.subtitle: Quick access to campaign state and the most common check roll.

checks.title: Ability check
checks.description: d20 + ability + modifiers, against 11 + difficulty (5 by default).
checks.modifiersHint: Add or subtract in steps of 5 for each advantage or disadvantage.

rules.title: Rules reference
rules.disclaimer: Own paraphrased summary of Knave 2e mechanics (not the book's original text). Covers the core play loop; bestiary, alchemy, relics, warfare and generator tables are out of scope for this version.

characters.title: Characters
characters.subtitle: Create and track the state of each party member.
characters.empty: No characters yet. Create the first one.

wizard.title: Character creation
wizard.name: Name
wizard.abilitiesHint: Distribute 3 points across the 6 abilities (more than 1 point can go on the same ability), or roll 3d6 to assign them automatically based on each die's number (1=STR, 2=DEX, 3=CON, 4=INT, 5=WIS, 6=CHA).
wizard.hpHint: Starting HP is 1d6. Item slots and the wound threshold are both 10 + CON.
wizard.careerHint: Enter career manually (the book's career table isn't bundled here). Add starting gear as real items so it takes up slots, and roll starting coins.
wizard.equipmentItemsHint: Add each piece of starting gear as an item: that way it takes up a slot from the start, just like on the character sheet.
wizard.armorHint: Each armor piece takes 1 slot and grants +1 AP, up to 7 pieces. AC = 11 + AP.

sheet.dead: The character has died: every slot is filled with wounds.
sheet.levelUpHint: Add +1 to three abilities of your choice (edit them above) and reroll the HP die, keeping the higher result.
sheet.inventoryHint: Mark an item as consumable (rations, arrows, torches, potions, etc.) so it can be spent one at a time with the Use button.
sheet.isArmor: Is armor (1 slot, +1 AP, max 7 pieces)
sheet.armorHint: Check 'Is armor' when adding a piece so it takes its slot and adds +1 to Armor Class.
sheet.armorMaxReached: You already have 7 armor pieces (the book's maximum). Remove one to add another.
sheet.spellbooksHint: Each spellbook takes one slot and holds a single spell. It can be used once per day; the PC can use a number of spellbooks per day equal to their INT.
sheet.blessingsHint: Active bonds with a patron (an aura, a minor blessing, etc.), which don't take up inventory slots.
sheet.blessingsCap: Suggested cap, equal to the character's CHA:
sheet.upkeepHint: Mark whether the character ate and slept well tonight. Without both, HP doesn't return to full (per the book's rule).
sheet.safeHaven: Resting in a safe haven (also heals 1 wound)
sheet.restSuccess: Ate and slept well: HP restored to full.
sheet.restFail: Missing food or a full night's sleep: HP isn't restored to full.
sheet.thirstDanger: 3+ days without water: daily CON check or die
sheet.confirmDelete: Delete this character? This action cannot be undone.

party.title: Party
party.subtitle: Pack animal / mount and the shared coin purse.

combat.title: Combat
combat.initiativeHint: CHA vs CHA between each side's leaders. The winner acts first.
combat.powerAttack: Power attack (doubles dice, breaks the weapon)

delving.title: Dungeon delving
delving.subtitle: 10-minute turns, movement speed, light, and the Dungeon Hazard Die.
delving.resolveTurn: Resolve turn (advances and rolls the Hazard Die)
delving.resolveHint: Advances one turn and rolls the Dungeon Hazard Die in a single step, applying the effect (e.g. burning out the torch) automatically.

speedDesc.crawling: The party automatically detects traps and can still map, at the cost of covering little ground.
speedDesc.walking: Normal speed: traps and ambushes trigger, but the party can keep mapping.
speedDesc.running: Last resort, used to flee: candles blow out, all traps trigger, and mapping is impossible.

lightDesc.none: In total darkness: -10 to movement/coordination checks, automatic surprise on encounters and traps, mapping is impossible.
lightDesc.torch: Torch: shapes at 40', detail at 10'. Takes 1 slot and burns out on a result of 3 on the Dungeon Hazard Die.
lightDesc.candle: Candle or lantern: shapes at 20', detail at 5'. Lasts the whole expedition, not affected by the Hazard Die.

delving.hazardHint: Roll it at the end of every turn and apply the result.

hazardResult.1: Encounter: a dungeon creature appears. Determine reaction, distance, and whether there's surprise.
hazardResult.2: Fatigue: every character loses 1 HP unless they spend the next turn resting.
hazardResult.3: Burn: lit torches burn out (they can be relit from the embers).
hazardResult.4: Shift: the dungeon environment changes (sounds, temperature, debris, something moves).
hazardResult.5: Sign: a clue appears that an encounter is nearby, or a hidden detail is revealed.

travel.title: Travel
travel.subtitle: 4-hour watches, hexes covered, and the Travel Hazard Die.
travel.resolveWatch: Resolve watch (advances and rolls the Hazard Die)
travel.resolveHint: Advances one watch and rolls the Travel Hazard Die in a single step, subtracting distance covered if you planned a trip.
travel.planHint: Enter the total distance or just the planned duration directly; the pace is calculated automatically based on whether you're mounted or terrain is difficult.
travel.plannedDays: Planned duration (days), if you already know it
travel.difficult: Difficult terrain / night / severe weather (x0.5 speed)
travel.extraWatch: Extra watch today: 1 direct damage to each PC unless they pass a CON check.
travel.applyExtraDamage: Apply 1 direct damage to the whole party
travel.extraDamageApplied: Applied 1 direct damage to every character in the party (ignore it for anyone who passes the CON check).
travel.hazardHint: Roll it at the end of each travel watch and apply the result.

hazardResult.1: Encounter: the party runs into a regional creature. Determine reaction, distance, and surprise.
hazardResult.2: Fatigue: every character loses 1 HP unless they rest next watch.
hazardResult.3: Depletion: roll a die for each perishable item (rations, etc.); on a 1 it spoils.
hazardResult.4: Shift: the weather changes or a local event begins.
hazardResult.5: Sign: a sign appears that an encounter is near in this hex.

travel.foragingHint: Takes a full watch. WIS check; on success the character gathers 1d6 rations.
